body.statement: There exists \(C<\infty\) such that the certified profiled band \((L_n,U_n)\) belongs to \(\mathfrak B_{n,\alpha}\) and satisfies \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal M}E_{P_{\mathrm{obs}}^{\otimes n}}[W_n]\le C r_n\) for all sufficiently large \(n\).
body.justification: This is the constructive half of the simultaneous-band frontier and includes the numerical certificate in the inferential object.
body.gap: Colangelo and Lee provide uniform-in-treatment ADRF inference when treatment is measured without error, while Huang and Zhang provide pointwise inference with a known error transform; neither confronts blind asymmetric-replicate deconvolution, and existing deconvolution bands target a density or regression under auxiliary or symmetric error information.
body.consumer: Nutrition and pollution studies with two nonidentical replicate measurements can report a uniformly valid ADRF band with an interpretable worst-case width.
